rules: Planetary simulation uses domain-specific LOD rather than simulating every individual at full fidelity.
Population totals, major settlements, infrastructure and political state remain conserved/traceable.
Routine changes may be aggregated; migrations, disasters, regime changes, wars, major construction and mass-casualty events require explicit records.
Environmental state evolves causally from prior state.
Off-screen economy and logistics cannot create or destroy critical resources without modeled causes.
When a persistent individual becomes relevant, materialization must be compatible with aggregated population history.
